title: Composition of coordinate restrictions
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to the signs, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs $z$ on the complement of $J$. Let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate one of three rules: leave it free, fix it to $1$, or fix it to $-1$. Applying the fixed assignment $z$ outside $J$ and then the rules $\rho$ agrees with first restricting $f$ to the coordinates in $J$ using $z$, reindexing those free coordinates by $J$, and applying at each reindexed coordinate the rule assigned by $\rho$ to its corresponding original coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
A sign assignment on the complement of $J$
A coordinate rule on every ambient coordinate
